1.english_reference: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying

traditions.WLC: וּ כְ כַלּ֤וֹת שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לְ הִתְפַּלֵּ֔ל
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ὡς συνετέλεσεν Σαλωμὼν προσευχόμενος ,
traditions.VUL: Cumque complésset Sálomon fundens preces ,
traditions.KJV: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying ,

1.english_reference: the fire came down from heaven , and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices

traditions.WLC: וְ הָ אֵ֗שׁ יָֽרְדָה֙ מֵֽ הַ שָּׁמַ֔יִם וַ תֹּ֥אכַל הָ עֹלָ֖ה וְ הַ זְּבָחִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸ πῦρ κατέβη ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ κατέφαγεν τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ τὰς θυσίας ,
traditions.VUL: ignis descéndit de cælo , et devorávit holocáusta et víctimas :
traditions.KJV: the fire came down from heaven , and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices ;

1.english_reference: and the glory of the LORD filled the house

traditions.WLC: וּ כְב֥וֹד יְהוָ֖ה מָלֵ֥א אֶת הַ בָּֽיִת
traditions.LXX: καὶ δόξα Κυρίου ἔπλησεν τὸν οἶκον .
traditions.VUL: et maιéstas Dómini implévit domum .
traditions.KJV: and the glory of the LORD filled the house .

2.english_reference: And the priests could not enter into the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֤א יָֽכְלוּ֙ הַ כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים לָ ב֖וֹא אֶל בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἠδύναντο οἱ ἱερεῖς εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὸν οἶκον Κυρίου ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ,
traditions.VUL: Nec póterant sacerdótes íngredi templum Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: And the priests could not enter into the house of the LORD ,

2.english_reference: because the glory of the LORD had filled the LORD ’S house

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי מָלֵ֥א כְבוֹד יְהוָ֖ה אֶת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἔπλησεν δόξα Κυρίου τὸν οἶκον .
traditions.VUL: eo quod implésset maιéstas Dómini templum Dómini .
traditions.KJV: because the glory of the LORD had filled the LORD ’S house .

3.english_reference: And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down , and the glory of the LORD upon the house

traditions.WLC: וְ כֹ֣ל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל רֹאִים֙ בְּ רֶ֣דֶת הָ אֵ֔שׁ וּ כְב֥וֹד יְהוָ֖ה עַל הַ בָּ֑יִת
traditions.LXX: καὶ πάντες οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ ἑώρων καταβαῖνον τὸ πῦρ , καὶ ἡ δόξα Κυρίου ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον ·
traditions.VUL: Sed et omnes fílii Israel vidébant descendéntem ignem , et glóriam Dómini super domum :
traditions.KJV: And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down , and the glory of the LORD upon the house ,

3.english_reference: they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּכְרְעוּ֩ אַפַּ֨יִם אַ֤רְצָ ה עַל הָ רִֽצְפָה֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔπεσον ἐπὶ πρόσωπον ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἐπὶ τὸ λιθόστρωτον ,
traditions.VUL: et corruéntes proni in terram super paviméntum stratum lápide ,
traditions.KJV: they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement ,

3.english_reference: and worshipped , and praised the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּֽשְׁתַּֽחֲו֔וּ וְ הוֹד֤וֹת לַ יהוָה֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ προσεκύνησαν καὶ ᾔνουν τῷ κυρίῳ
traditions.VUL: adoravérunt , et laudavérunt Dóminum :
traditions.KJV: and worshipped , and praised the LORD , [ saying ] ,

3.english_reference: For [ he is ] good ; for his mercy [ endureth ] for ever

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב כִּ֥י לְ עוֹלָ֖ם חַסְדּֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: Ὅτι ἀγαθόν , ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: Quóniam bonus , quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia eius .
traditions.KJV: For [ he is ] good ; for his mercy [ endureth ] for ever .

4.english_reference: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ וְ כָל הָ עָ֑ם זֹבְחִ֥ים זֶ֖בַח לִ פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς θύοντες θύματα ἔναντι Κυρίου .
traditions.VUL: Rex autem , et omnis pópulus immolábant víctimas coram Dómino .
traditions.KJV: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD .

5.english_reference: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּזְבַּ֞ח הַ מֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה֮ אֶת זֶ֣בַח הַ בָּקָ֗ר עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּ שְׁנַ֨יִם֙ אֶ֔לֶף
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐθυσίασεν Σαλωμὼν τὴν θυσίαν , μόσχων εἴκοσι καὶ δύο χιλιάδες ·
traditions.VUL: Mactávit ígitur rex Sálomon hóstias , boum vigínti duo míllia ,
traditions.KJV: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen ,

5.english_reference: and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep

traditions.WLC: וְ צֹ֕אן מֵאָ֥ה וְ עֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף
traditions.VUL: aríetum centum vigínti míllia :
traditions.KJV: and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep :

5.english_reference: so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יַּחְנְכוּ֙ אֶת בֵּ֣ית הָֽ אֱלֹהִ֔ים הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ וְ כָל הָ עָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐνεκαίνισεν τὸν οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ ὁ βασιλεύς · καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς
traditions.VUL: et dedicávit domum Dei rex , et univérsus pópulus .
traditions.KJV: so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God .

6.english_reference: And the priests waited on their offices

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ כֹּהֲנִ֞ים עַל מִשְׁמְרוֹתָ֣ ם עֹמְדִ֗ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς ἐπὶ τὰς φυλακὰς αὐτῶν ἑστηκότες ,
traditions.VUL: Sacerdótes autem stabant in offíciis suis ,
traditions.KJV: And the priests waited on their offices :

6.english_reference: the Levites also with instruments of musick of the LORD , which David the king had made to praise the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ לְוִיִּ֞ם בִּ כְלֵי שִׁ֤יר יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה דָּוִ֣יד הַ מֶּ֗לֶךְ לְ הֹד֤וֹת לַ יהוָה֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ Λευεῖται ἐν ὀργάνοις ᾠδῶν Κυρίου τοῦ Δαυεὶδ τοῦ βασιλέως τοῦ ἐξομολογεῖσθαι ἔναντι Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: et Levítæ in órganis cárminum Dómini , quæ fecit David rex ad laudándum Dóminum :
traditions.KJV: the Levites also with instruments of musick of the LORD , which David the king had made to praise the LORD ,

6.english_reference: because his mercy [ endureth ] for ever , when David praised by their ministry

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי לְ עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּ֔ וֹ בְּ הַלֵּ֥ל דָּוִ֖יד בְּ יָדָ֑ ם
traditions.LXX: ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ , ἐν ὕμνοις Δαυεὶδ διὰ χειρὸς αὐτῶν ·
traditions.VUL: Quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius , hymnos David canéntes per manus suas :
traditions.KJV: because his mercy [ endureth ] for ever , when David praised by their ministry ;

6.english_reference: and the priests sounded trumpets before them , and all Israel stood

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ כֹּהֲנִים֙ מחצצרים נֶגְדָּ֔ ם וְ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֹמְדִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς σαλπίζοντες ταῖς σάλπιγξιν ἐναντίον αὐτῶν , καὶ πᾶς Ἰσραὴλ ἑστηκώς .
traditions.VUL: porro sacerdótes canébant tubis ante eos , cunctúsque Israel stabat .
traditions.KJV: and the priests sounded trumpets before them , and all Israel stood .

7.english_reference: Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that [ was ] before the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַ יְקַדֵּ֣שׁ שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אֶת תּ֤וֹךְ הֶֽ חָצֵר֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ לִ פְנֵ֣י בֵית יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡγίασεν Σαλωμὼν τὸ μέσον τῆς αὐλῆς τῆς ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου ·
traditions.VUL: Sanctificávit quoque Sálomon médium átrii ante templum Dómini :
traditions.KJV: Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that [ was ] before the house of the LORD :

7.english_reference: for there he offered burnt offerings , and the fat of the peace offerings

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי עָ֤שָׂה שָׁם֙ הָֽ עֹל֔וֹת וְ אֵ֖ת חֶלְבֵ֣י הַ שְּׁלָמִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐποίησεν ἐκεῖ τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ τὰ στέατα τῶν σωτηρίων ,
traditions.VUL: obtúlerat enim ibi holocáusta et ádipes pacificórum :
traditions.KJV: for there he offered burnt offerings , and the fat of the peace offerings ,

7.english_reference: because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings , and the meat offerings , and the fat

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי מִזְבַּ֤ח הַ נְּחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה לֹ֣א יָכ֗וֹל לְ הָכִ֛יל אֶת הָ עֹלָ֥ה וְ אֶת הַ מִּנְחָ֖ה וְ אֶת הַ חֲלָבִֽים
traditions.LXX: ὅτι τὸ θυσιαστήριον τὸ χαλκοῦν ὃ ἐποίησεν Σαλωμὼν οὐκ ἐξεποίει δέξασθαι τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ τὰ μαναὰ καὶ τὰ στέατα .
traditions.VUL: quia altáre ǽneum , quod fécerat , non póterat sustinére holocáusta et sacrifícia et ádipes .
traditions.KJV: because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings , and the meat offerings , and the fat .

8.english_reference: Also at the same time Solomon kept the feast seven days , and all Israel with him

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֣עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה אֶת הֶ֠ חָג בָּ עֵ֨ת הַ הִ֜יא שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ וְ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עִמּ֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν Σαλωμὼν τὴν ἑορτὴν ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ἑπτὰ ἡμέραις , καὶ πᾶς Ἰσραὴλ μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Fecit ergo Sálomon solemnitátem in témpore illo septem diébus , et omnis Israel cum eo ,
traditions.KJV: Also at the same time Solomon kept the feast seven days , and all Israel with him ,

8.english_reference: a very great congregation , from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt

traditions.WLC: קָהָ֖ל גָּד֣וֹל מְאֹ֑ד מִ לְּב֥וֹא חֲמָ֖ת עַד נַ֥חַל מִצְרָֽיִם
traditions.LXX: ἐκκλησία μεγάλη σφόδρα ἀπὸ εἰσόδου Αἱμὰθ καὶ ἕως χειμάρρου Αἰγύπτου .
traditions.VUL: ecclésia magna valde , ab intróitu Emath usque ad torréntem Ægýpti .
traditions.KJV: a very great congregation , from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt .

9.english_reference: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יַּעֲשׂ֛וּ בַּ יּ֥וֹם הַ שְּׁמִינִ֖י עֲצָ֑רֶת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ὀγδόῃ ἐξόδιον ,
traditions.VUL: Fecítque die octávo colléctam ,
traditions.KJV: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly :

9.english_reference: for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days , and the feast seven days

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י חֲנֻכַּ֣ת הַ מִּזְבֵּ֗חַ עָשׂוּ֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים וְ הֶ חָ֖ג שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐνκαινισμὸν τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου ἐποίησεν ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας ἑορτήν ,
traditions.VUL: eo quod dedicásset altáre septem diébus , et solemnitátem celebrásset diébus septem .
traditions.KJV: for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days , and the feast seven days .

10.english_reference: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ י֨וֹם עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּ שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ לַ חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ שְּׁבִיעִ֔י שִׁלַּ֥ח אֶת הָ עָ֖ם לְ אָהֳלֵי הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν τῇ τρίτῃ καὶ εἰκοστῇ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ ἑβδόμου ἀπέστειλεν τὸν λαὸν εἰς τὰ σκηνώματα αὐτῶν
traditions.VUL: Igitur in die vigésimo tértio mensis séptimi , dimísit pópulos ad tabernácula sua ,
traditions.KJV: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents ,

10.english_reference: glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the LORD had shewed unto David , and to Solomon , and to Israel his people

traditions.WLC: שְׂמֵחִים֙ וְ ט֣וֹבֵי לֵ֔ב עַל הַ טּוֹבָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לְ דָוִ֣יד וְ לִ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וּ לְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַמּֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: εὐφραινομένους καὶ ἀγαθῇ καρδίᾳ ἐπὶ τοῖς ἀγαθοῖς οἷς ἐποίησεν Κύριος τῷ Δαυεὶδ καὶ τῷ Σαλωμὼν καὶ τῷ Ἰσραὴλ λαῷ αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: lætántes atque gaudéntes super bono , quod fécerat Dóminus Davídi , et Salomóni , et Israéli pópulo suo .
traditions.KJV: glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the LORD had shewed unto David , and to Solomon , and to Israel his people .

11.english_reference: Thus Solomon finished the house of the LORD , and the king ’s house

traditions.WLC: וַ יְכַ֧ל שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה אֶת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה וְ אֶת בֵּ֣ית הַ מֶּ֑לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: Καὶ συνετέλεσεν Σαλωμὼν τὸν οἶκον Κυρίου καὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ βασιλέως ,
traditions.VUL: Complevítque Sálomon domum Dómini , et domum regis ,
traditions.KJV: Thus Solomon finished the house of the LORD , and the king ’s house :

11.english_reference: and all that came into Solomon ’s heart to make in the house of the LORD , and in his own house , he prosperously effected .

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵ֨ת כָּל הַ בָּ֜א עַל לֵ֣ב שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה לַ עֲשׂ֧וֹת בְּ בֵית יְהוָ֛ה וּ בְ בֵית֖ וֹ הִצְלִֽיחַ
traditions.LXX: καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησεν ἐν τῇ ψυχῇ Σαλωμὼν τοῦ ποιῆσαι ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου καὶ ἐν οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ εὐοδώθη .
traditions.VUL: et ómnia quæ disposúerat in corde suo , ut fáceret in domo Dómini , et in domo sua , et prosperátus est .
traditions.KJV: and all that came into Solomon ’s heart to make in the house of the LORD , and in his own house , he prosperously effected .

12.english_reference: And the LORD appeared to Solomon by night , and said unto him

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּרָ֧א יְהוָ֛ה אֶל שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בַּ לָּ֑יְלָה וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὤφθη ὁ θεὸς τῷ Σαλωμὼν τὴν νύκτα καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ
traditions.VUL: Appáruit autem ei Dóminus nocte , et ait :
traditions.KJV: And the LORD appeared to Solomon by night , and said unto him ,

traditions.WLC: שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי֙ אֶת תְּפִלָּתֶ֔ ךָ
traditions.LXX: Ἤκουσα τῆς προσευχῆς σου ,
traditions.VUL: Audívi oratiónem tuam ,
traditions.KJV: I have heard thy prayer ,

12.english_reference: and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice .

traditions.WLC: וּ בָחַ֜רְתִּי בַּ מָּק֥וֹם הַ זֶּ֛ה לִ֖ י לְ בֵ֥ית זָֽבַח
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξελεξάμην ἐν τῷ τόπῳ τούτῳ ἐμαυτῷ εἰς οἶκον θυσίας .
traditions.VUL: et elégi locum istum mihi in domum sacrifícii .
traditions.KJV: and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice .

13.english_reference: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain

traditions.WLC: הֵ֣ן אֶֽעֱצֹ֤ר הַ שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ וְ לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֣ה מָטָ֔ר
traditions.LXX: ἐὰν συσχῶ τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ μὴ γένηται ὑετός ,
traditions.VUL: Si cláusero cælum , et plúvia non flúxerit ,
traditions.KJV: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain ,

13.english_reference: or if I command the locusts to devour the land

traditions.WLC: וְ הֵן אֲצַוֶּ֥ה עַל חָגָ֖ב לֶ אֱכ֣וֹל הָ אָ֑רֶץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐὰν ἐντείλωμαι τῇ ἀκρίδι καταφαγεῖν τὸ ξύλον ,
traditions.VUL: et mandávero et præcépero locústæ ut dévoret terram ,
traditions.KJV: or if I command the locusts to devour the land ,

13.english_reference: or if I send pestilence among my people ;

traditions.WLC: וְ אִם אֲשַׁלַּ֥ח דֶּ֖בֶר בְּ עַמִּֽ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐὰν ἀποστείλω θάνατον ἐν τῷ λαῷ μου ,
traditions.VUL: et mísero pestiléntiam in pópulum meum :
traditions.KJV: or if I send pestilence among my people ;

14.english_reference: If my people , which are called by my name , shall humble themselves

traditions.WLC: וְ יִכָּנְע֨וּ עַמִּ֜ י אֲשֶׁ֧ר נִֽקְרָא שְׁמִ֣ י עֲלֵי הֶ֗ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐὰν ἐντραπῇ ὁ λαός μου ἐφ᾽ οὓς τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐπικέκληται ἐπ᾽ αὐτούς ,
traditions.VUL: convérsus autem pópulus meus , super quos invocátum est nomen meum ,
traditions.KJV: If my people , which are called by my name , shall humble themselves ,

14.english_reference: and pray , and seek my face , and turn from their wicked ways ;

traditions.WLC: וְ יִֽתְפַּֽלְלוּ֙ וִֽ יבַקְשׁ֣וּ פָנַ֔ י וְ יָשֻׁ֖בוּ מִ דַּרְכֵי הֶ֣ם הָ רָעִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ προσεύξωνται καὶ ζητήσωσιν τὸ πρόσωπόν μου , καὶ ἀποστρέψωσιν ἀπὸ τῶν ὁδῶν αὐτῶν τῶν πονηρῶν ,
traditions.VUL: deprecátus me fúerit , et exquisíerit fáciem meam , et égerit pœniténtiam a viis suis péssimis :
traditions.KJV: and pray , and seek my face , and turn from their wicked ways ;

14.english_reference: then will I hear from heaven , and will forgive their sin , and will heal their land .

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲנִי֙ אֶשְׁמַ֣ע מִן הַ שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ אֶסְלַח֙ לְ חַטָּאתָ֔ ם וְ אֶרְפָּ֖א אֶת אַרְצָֽ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγὼ εἰσακούσομαι ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἵλεως ἔσομαι ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις αὐτῶν καὶ ἰάσομαι τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: et ego exáudiam de cælo , et propítius ero peccátis eórum , et sanábo terram eórum .
traditions.KJV: then will I hear from heaven , and will forgive their sin , and will heal their land .

15.english_reference: Now mine eyes shall be open

traditions.WLC: עַתָּ֗ה עֵינַ י֙ יִהְי֣וּ פְתֻח֔וֹת
traditions.LXX: νῦν οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ἔσονται ἀνεῳγμένοι
traditions.VUL: Oculi quoque mei erunt apérti ,
traditions.KJV: Now mine eyes shall be open ,

15.english_reference: and mine ears attent unto the prayer [ that is made ] in this place .

traditions.WLC: וְ אָזְנַ֖ י קַשֻּׁב֑וֹת לִ תְפִלַּ֖ת הַ מָּק֥וֹם הַ זֶּֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰ ὦτά μου ἐπήκοα τῆς προσευχῆς τοῦ τόπου τούτου .
traditions.VUL: et aures meæ eréctæ ad oratiónem eius , qui in loco isto oráverit .
traditions.KJV: and mine ears attent unto the prayer [ that is made ] in this place .

16.english_reference: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house , that my name may be there for ever :

traditions.WLC: וְ עַתָּ֗ה בָּחַ֤רְתִּי וְ הִקְדַּ֨שְׁתִּי֙ אֶת הַ בַּ֣יִת הַ זֶּ֔ה לִ הְיוֹת שְׁמִ֥ י שָׁ֖ם עַד עוֹלָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν ἐξελεξάμην καὶ ἡγίακα τὸν οἶκον τοῦτον τοῦ εἶναι ὄνομά μου ἐκεῖ ἕως αἰῶνος ,
traditions.VUL: Elégi enim , et sanctificávi locum istum , ut sit nomen meum ibi in sempitérnum ,
traditions.KJV: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house , that my name may be there for ever :

16.english_reference: and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually .

traditions.WLC: וְ הָי֨וּ עֵינַ֧ י וְ לִבִּ֛ י שָׁ֖ם כָּל הַ יָּמִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσονται οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου καὶ ἡ καρδία μου ἐκεῖ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας .
traditions.VUL: et permáneant óculi mei , et cor meum ibi cunctis diébus .
traditions.KJV: and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually .

17.english_reference: And as for thee , if thou wilt walk before me , as David thy father walked

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתָּ֞ה אִם תֵּלֵ֣ךְ לְ פָנַ֗ י כַּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָלַךְ֙ דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֔י ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ σὺ ἐὰν πορευθῇς ἐναντίον μου ὡς Δαυεὶδ ὁ πατήρ σου ,
traditions.VUL: Tu quoque si ambuláveris coram me , sicut ambulávit David pater tuus ,
traditions.KJV: And as for thee , if thou wilt walk before me , as David thy father walked ,

17.english_reference: and do according to all that I have commanded thee

traditions.WLC: וְ לַ עֲשׂ֕וֹת כְּ כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֑י ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ποιήσῃς κατὰ πάντα ἃ ἐνετειλάμην σοι ,
traditions.VUL: et féceris iuxta ómnia , quæ præcépi tibi ,
traditions.KJV: and do according to all that I have commanded thee ,

17.english_reference: and shalt observe my statutes and my judgments ;

traditions.WLC: וְ חֻקַּ֥ י וּ מִשְׁפָּטַ֖ י תִּשְׁמֽוֹר
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰ προστάγματά μου καὶ τὰ κρίματά μου φυλάξῃ ,
traditions.VUL: et iustítias meas iudiciáque serváveris :
traditions.KJV: and shalt observe my statutes and my judgments ;

18.english_reference: Then will I stablish the throne of thy kingdom , according as I have covenanted with David thy father

traditions.WLC: וַ הֲקִ֣ימוֹתִ֔י אֵ֖ת כִּסֵּ֣א מַלְכוּתֶ֑ ךָ כַּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּרַ֗תִּי לְ דָוִ֤יד אָבִ֨י ךָ֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀναστήσω τὸν θρόνον τῆς βασιλείας σου ὡς διεθέμην Δαυεὶδ τῷ πατρί σου
traditions.VUL: suscitábo thronum regni tui , sicut pollícitus sum David patri tuo ,
traditions.KJV: Then will I stablish the throne of thy kingdom , according as I have covenanted with David thy father ,

18.english_reference: saying , There shall not fail thee a man [ to be ] ruler in Israel .

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹ֔ר לֹֽא יִכָּרֵ֤ת לְ ךָ֙ אִ֔ישׁ מוֹשֵׁ֖ל בְּ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: λέγων Οὐκ ἐξαρθήσεταί σοι ἀνὴρ ἡγούμενος ἐν Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: dicens : Non auferétur de stirpe tua vir , qui sit princeps in Israel .
traditions.KJV: saying , There shall not fail thee a man [ to be ] ruler in Israel .

19.english_reference: But if ye turn away , and forsake my statutes and my commandments , which I have set before you

traditions.WLC: וְ אִם תְּשׁוּב֣וּ ן אַתֶּ֔ם וַ עֲזַבְתֶּם֙ חֻקּוֹתַ֣ י וּ מִצְוֺתַ֔ י אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִ פְנֵי כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐὰν ἀποστρέψητε ὑμεῖς , καὶ ἐνκαταλίπητε τὰ προστάγματά μου καὶ τὰς ἐντολάς μου ἃς ἔδωκα ἐναντίον ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Si autem avérsi fuéritis , et dereliquéritis iustítias meas , et præcépta mea , quæ propósui vobis ,
traditions.KJV: But if ye turn away , and forsake my statutes and my commandments , which I have set before you ,

19.english_reference: and shall go and serve other gods , and worship them ;

traditions.WLC: וַ הֲלַכְתֶּ֗ם וַ עֲבַדְתֶּם֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְ הִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם לָ הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ πορευθῆτε καὶ λατρεύσητε θεοῖς ἑτέροις καὶ προσκυνήσητε αὐτοῖς ,
traditions.VUL: et abeúntes serviéritis diis aliénis , et adoravéritis eos :
traditions.KJV: and shall go and serve other gods , and worship them ;

20.english_reference: Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them ;

traditions.WLC: וּ נְתַשְׁתִּ֗י ם מֵ עַ֤ל אַדְמָתִ י֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תִּי לָ הֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξαρῶ ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἧς ἔδωκα αὐτοῖς ,
traditions.VUL: evéllam vos de terra mea , quam dedi vobis :
traditions.KJV: Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them ;

20.english_reference: and this house , which I have sanctified for my name , will I cast out of my sight

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת הַ בַּ֤יִת הַ זֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְדַּ֣שְׁתִּי לִ שְׁמִ֔ י אַשְׁלִ֖יךְ מֵ עַ֣ל פָּנָ֑ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦτον ὃν ἡγίασα τῷ ὀνόματί μου ἀποστρέψω ἐκ προσώπου μου ,
traditions.VUL: et domum hanc , quam sanctificávi nómini meo , proíciam a fácie mea ,
traditions.KJV: and this house , which I have sanctified for my name , will I cast out of my sight ,

20.english_reference: and will make it [ to be ] a proverb and a byword among all nations .

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶתְּנֶ֛ נּוּ לְ מָשָׁ֥ל וְ לִ שְׁנִינָ֖ה בְּ כָל הָ עַמִּֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ δώσω αὐτὸν εἰς παραβολὴν καὶ εἰς διήγημα ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν .
traditions.VUL: et tradam eam in parábolam , et in exémplum cunctis pópulis .
traditions.KJV: and will make it [ to be ] a proverb and a byword among all nations .

21.english_reference: And this house , which is high ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ בַּ֤יִת הַ זֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה עֶלְי֔וֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὁ οἶκος οὗτος ὁ ὑψηλός ,
traditions.VUL: Et domus ista erit in provérbium
traditions.KJV: And this house , which is high ,

21.english_reference: shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it ;

traditions.WLC: לְ כָל עֹבֵ֥ר עָלָ֖י ו יִשֹּׁ֑ם
traditions.LXX: πᾶς ὁ διαπορευόμενος αὐτὸν ἐκστήσεται
traditions.VUL: univérsis transeúntibus ,
traditions.KJV: shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it ;

traditions.WLC: וְ אָמַ֗ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐρεῖ
traditions.VUL: et dicent stupéntes :
traditions.KJV: so that he shall say ,

21.english_reference: Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land , and unto this house ?

traditions.WLC: בַּ מֶּ֨ה עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ כָּ֔כָה לָ אָ֥רֶץ הַ זֹּ֖את וְ לַ בַּ֥יִת הַ זֶּֽה
traditions.LXX: Χάριν τίνος ἐποίησεν Κύριος τῇ γῇ ταύτῃ καὶ τῷ οἴκῳ τούτῳ ;
traditions.VUL: Quare fecit Dóminus sic terræ huic , et dómui huic ?
traditions.KJV: Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land , and unto this house ?

22.english_reference: And it shall be answered , Because they forsook the LORD God of their fathers ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אָמְר֗וּ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָֽזְב֜וּ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹתֵי הֶ֗ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐροῦσιν Διότι ἐνκατέλιπον Κύριον θεὸν τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν
traditions.VUL: Respondebúntque : Quia dereliquérunt Dóminum Deum patrum suórum ,
traditions.KJV: And it shall be answered , Because they forsook the LORD God of their fathers ,

22.english_reference: which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt ,

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוֹצִיאָ ם֮ מֵ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒
traditions.LXX: τὸν ἐξαγαγόντα αὐτοὺς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου ,
traditions.VUL: qui edúxit eos de terra Ægýpti ,
traditions.KJV: which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt ,

22.english_reference: and laid hold on other gods , and worshipped them , and served them :

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יַּחֲזִ֨יקוּ֙ בֵּ אלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַ יִּשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לָ הֶ֖ם וַ יַּֽעַבְד֑וּ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀντελάβοντο θεῶν ἑτέρων καὶ προσκυνήσαν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐδούλευσαν αὐτοῖς ·
traditions.VUL: et apprehendérunt deos aliénos , et adoravérunt eos , et coluérunt :
traditions.KJV: and laid hold on other gods , and worshipped them , and served them :

22.english_reference: therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them .

traditions.WLC: עַל כֵּן֙ הֵבִ֣יא עֲלֵי הֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת כָּל הָ רָעָ֖ה הַ זֹּֽאת
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο ἐπήγαγεν ἐπ᾽ αὐτοὺς πᾶσαν τὴν κακίαν ταύτην .
traditions.VUL: idcírco venérunt super eos univérsa hæc mala .
traditions.KJV: therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them .
